name: xion-local-memory-inference-p1b6-source-audit-protocol-v1
question: Given the complete frozen source episode, the exact selected model-visible bundle, and the source-grounded single TARGET anchor, could any omitted source material materially change, resolve, contradict, or otherwise alter the interpretation of the anchored candidate or its CLEAR/ESCALATE judgment?

dispositions.PASS: No omitted source evidence appears capable of materially changing the candidate interpretation.
dispositions.FAIL: Material omitted source evidence exists, or another semantic bundle-selection defect makes this selected bundle incomplete.
dispositions.UNCERTAIN: The auditor cannot confidently determine completeness.

outputContract.reason: Short construction-diagnostic reason only; it is not ambiguity gold.

constraints: The auditor does not assign CLEAR or ESCALATE.
Only PASS may proceed to later blind HUMAN semantic review.
This protocol does not authorize source edits, HUMAN review, training, or production use.
